# <The choice, stated as a rule>

Copy to `docs/decisions/YYYYMMDD_<slug>.md`, dated the day it was made. Never rewrite an accepted
decision; write a new one and set this one `superseded` with `superseded_by`.

## Context

The situation and problem that forced a choice.

## Decision

What was chosen, stated precisely.

## Why

The reasoning that made this option win.

## Alternatives

What else was considered and why it lost.

## Impact

What this changes or commits us to (docs, code, scope, cost, risk), and what would make us revisit it.

## Who

Product or developer decision; who made it (named, so they can be asked again); for an agent, its session id and who approved it.
